meaning:
κατα-χθόνιος, -ον
(χθών, the earth),
subterranean, under the earth (in cl., of the infernal gods): of the departed in Hades, opposite to ἐπουράνιος, ἐπίγειος, Php.2:10.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,
